items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: I spent countless hours with Jim Fulcher on Odessa. Jazz was our interest -- we had several interests, such as bird hunting we discussed that.

ctx.x: Now to finish off one party, this one party that I just started, was Red Norvo on vibraphones, and Ducky Pizzarelli on guitar, and Herb Ellis on guitar. This line for a solid week should be awe inspiring for a jazz buff, or a musician.

To bring th is discourse to an end, I spent countless hours with Jim Fulcher on Odessa. Jazz was our interest -- we had several interests, such as bird hunting we discussed that. I never got to accept his invitation to
join him. He owned bird dogs and did much dove and quail hunting.
